Hi Danielle / StratoPay team,

Thanks again for last week's demo. Attached is the first pass of the MAP action roster focused on SOC 2 readiness, DPA edits, audit-log evidence, and the pen test scope we discussed. Please find preliminary owners and ETA columns filled — these are draft and intended for this weekly checkpoint.

- DPA: proposed edits attached (DPA_revision_v3.docx). Procurement to confirm clause language.
- Audit logs: sample retention export scheduled for 4/13; Marissa to share export link.
- Pen test: scope doc attached (pen_test_scope.pdf). We proposed external vendor SecureAssess — copy on this thread.

Request for this week:
1) Danielle, confirm whether StratoPay requires an addendum for logging retention by 4/15.
2) Procurement, please review DPA edits and send redlines by 4/16.
3) SecureAssess, can you confirm availability for a kickoff the week of 4/26?

I’ve linked the HubSpot MAP and added a DocuSign placeholder for future SOWs. Let me know if you want a 30-min sync later this week.

Thanks,

Laura — thanks for the clear deck and the roster. Quick notes:  

- Logging retention: we have a legal requirement to retain auth/audit logs for 3 years; we will need to see the exact retention and access controls. I'll confirm by 4/15.
- DPA: Procurement will circulate redlines. Expect them by 4/16 EOD.
- Pen test: SecureAssess looks fine; availability is a separate question.

Action for Redwood: can you provide a sample export of the audit-log schema and a short note on how keys/PII are redacted? That will help our compliance team sign off.

Also, we prefer the SSO-based artifact access flow rather than shared credentials — please confirm that is supported.

Thanks,
Danielle
Head of Cloud Security, StratoPay
danielle@stratopay.com
